title: REM universality for linear random energy
summary: We consider a sequence of random Hamiltonians $H_n(h,σ)=\sum^n_{i=1}h_i(σ_i-m)$, and study the asymptotic ($n\to \infty$) distribution of the energy levels $(H_n(h,σ))_{σ\in \{-1,1\}^n}$, where $h_1,h_2,\cdots$ are i.i.d. random variables. We show that, when $e^{O(n)}$ configurations are sampled at random, the corresponding collection of energy levels converges in distribution to a Poisson point process with exponential intensity measure.
